<Color:7>Personality<Color:Default> affects how condition varies. It may
change through breeding.

Earnest: Unlikely to be Lousy or Perfect.
Rogue: Often Poor, but has Good or Perfect runs.
Fickle: Often Perfect, but Lousy just as often.
Moody: Often Good or Perfect, but stops often.

There are three <Color:7>running styles<Color:Default>. They may change
from breeding.

Normal: Gradually speeds up.
Sprint: Hits top speed early; gradually fades.
Distance: Initially slow; strong second half.

Select <Color:7>Train a Cochin<Color:Default> from the main page to
have a trainer work on a bird in exchange for a
gift. <Color:7>The more expensive a gift, the better the
parameter gain.<Color:Default> Each trainer has an area they
focus on when training birds. Though rare, your
Cochin may learn a skill. Cochins cannot be
trained beyond their potential, but their growth
potential can be extended through breeding.

Select <Color:7>Breeding<Color:Default> from the main page to breed
your Cochin with a hen of your choice.

Breeding has the following effects:

<Color:16>- Boosts parameter growth limits.<Color:Default>
<Color:16>- Passes on skills.<Color:Default>
<Color:16>- Reduces the race limit to zero.<Color:Default>
<Color:16>- If there are five skills, one is forgotten.<Color:Default>
<Color:16>- A new skill may be learned.<Color:Default>
<Color:16>- The personality may change.<Color:Default>
<Color:16>- The running style may change.<Color:Default>

Breeding is free, but the Cochin must <Color:7>run a
certain number of races<Color:Default> before it can breed.

There are four classes, each with five races.
A Cochin can advance to a higher class only by
winning all five races in a class.

By satisfying certain conditions, a Cochin can
earn titles after racing. View them by selecting
<Color:7>View Titles<Color:Default> from the main page.

Your bird can earn prestigious titles, such as:


- Flash: Leg Power of 500 or more.
- Peerless: Win 3 in a row with the same bird.
- Challenger: Win a race in Challenger Class.
You're leaving? Come by again when you can.
This is the Kineicho Branch of Kamiyama Works. What can I do for you?
Great, I'll be sure to let Kamiyama know. What're you going to invest?
What do you want to know about?

Kamiyama Works is a custom weapon and gear shop operated by the Kamiyama brothers. They craft a wide variety of equipment for a fee. Better weapons and protective gear will improve your chances against tough foes.

Weapons have limited durability⑬once durability drops to zero, the weapon becomes unusable until it is <Color:7>repaired or reloaded<Color:Default> at a Kamiyama Works shop or with a <Color:7>Repair Kit<Color:Default>. (You will not lose the weapon if its durability is depleted.)

For the most part, equipment is produced in exchange for money. Some require additional materials.
The range of offerings widens as the <Color:7>shop level<Color:Default> rises. The shop level can be raised by <Color:7>investing<Color:Default> in the shop.

All weapons are ranked (indicated by stars). The number of stars indicates the <Color:7>weapon skill level needed to equip the weapon<Color:Default>. You can view weapon skill levels under Abilities in the Pause Menu.
You can invest in Kamiyama Works by selecting <Color:7>Invest<Color:Default> from Kamiyama's menu. Investing raises the shop level, enabling the crafting of better weapons and protective gear.
Some weapons and protective gear become available only if certain materials are donated as investments. Kamiyama Works will accept any item as an investment.
Can I do anything else for you?
You know where to find us if you need anything.
Howdy. This is the Sotenbori Branch of Kamiyama Works. How can I serve you today?
Great. I'll let Kamiyama know about your investment. What will it be?
This is the Tsukimino Branch of Kamiyama Works. What can I do for you today?
Thanks! I'll make sure Kamiyama gets everything. So what are you going to invest?
We're always here if you need us.
Kazuma Kiryu?
Word is you're undefeated here at the Underground Coliseum.
The name's Raiden.
Ah...
What kind of greeting is that?
I've yet to sign up for the qualifier, but we'll be facing each other soon enough.
I heard the qualifying round here in Kamuro is packed with strong contenders. Hope you'll be rooting for me to make it to the finals.
Why would I do that? I don't know you.
Sorry. I don't know your customs here in Japan.
What a peaceful nation this must be to have such a tournament as entertainment. Your fat cats must be really starved for blood.
Are you done?
Yeah, that's all I wanted to say.
(Raiden... Seems he'll be in the qualifier. Probably means I'll run into him in town.)
*huff* *cough*
And the winner is... Kazuma Kiryu! The Dragon of Dojima is the Victory Road champion!
It's over, Raiden.
I don't understand. How could I have lost to someone like you? Your country... it's soft and weak!
It doesn't matter if you survive in a living hell for a hundred years. It takes more than that to be strong.
What? What are you talking about?
You're obsessed with your tortured past, but true strength is more than that.
What a load of bullshit! How could a coward like you know what I've been through!?
You're just another fool who wears his misfortunes like a badge of honor. This country's full of 'em.
The hell'd you say!?
Fools like you want to make others suffer just like they did. And they always seek to victimize those who are weaker than themselves.
Parents beat their kids and say it's because they were abused as children. Swindlers claim they were victims of fraud.
But true strength is overcoming that kind of misery, not perpetuating it.
You'll never defeat me as long as you think your suffering gives you a right to make others miserable, too.
Damn you! Damn you to hell!
Kazuma Kiryu!!!
What can I do for you today?
What will you invest?
What would you like to know?

For the most part, equipment is produced in exchange for money. Some require additional materials. The range of offerings widens as the <Color:7>shop level<Color:Default> rises. The shop level can be raised by <Color:7>investing<Color:Default> in the shop.
Thank you. Anything else?
Please come again.
I'm all outta cash... I'm all outta schemes... The hell am I gonna do?
Uh, you okay there?
Augh! Goddammit! You nearly scared the piss outta me!
Hm? Hey, I know you. Seen you at the race track.
What race track? Oh, could you mean the Cochin Cup?
Yeah. Ukai was showin' you around, right? Great, then I'll get straight to the point!
How would you like a brand-new cock, sir?
Whoa! Just like that?
He's one heckuva bird, lemme tell ya. He's got the chops to go for the Champion Class, but right now I'm really strapped for cash.
There's a turf war brewin', so I gotta load up on supplies at that there shop...
Oops, never mind, you didn't hear that. So, how 'bout that Cochin? Yours for only a hundred grand!
(Oof. Now that's a big-budget bird... But still, it would be nice to win that cup.)
Then we got ourselves a deal.
You handed over <Color:8>100,000 yen<Color:Default>.
You got a <Color:8>Cochin Chicken with Piercing Eyes<Color:Default>.
What, too expensive for ya? This boy's got rockets on his feet, ya know.
Okay, fine, I'll sweeten the deal. Take my boy for only 30,000 yen. It's a steal at that price!
You handed over <Color:8>30,000 yen<Color:Default>.
You got <Color:8>Cochin Chicken with Piercing Eyes<Color:Default>.
You're hagglin' me down even more? You're takin' me to the cleaners here! Have some pity.
...But beggars can't be choosers. This is my final offer. It's grand larceny at a mere 10,000 yen. Now buy my bird already!
Okay, we got ourselves a deal. You sure stuck it to me, though. What a deal you got! But, that's how it goes.
You handed over <Color:8>10,000 yen<Color:Default>.
That so... Well, I can't go any lower. Come back when you got real money to spend.

What, you're broke? I ain't some kinda chicken charity here.
Come back when you got real money to spend.
Oh, it's you. Changed your mind about buying my cock?
Okay, fella, raise my boy right. I'm tellin ya, he'll take you to the poultry Promised Land!
Ah, what timing!
I saw you at the Cochin racetrack. As a fellow owner, I gotta commend you on a job well done.
Oh, thanks. Us chickenmeisters gotta stick together, right?
I'll be a former chickenmeister soon enough. I'm leaving town to work in Macau for a year.
Macau? Whoa, that's like, the gambling capital of the world! I envy you, man.
Yeah, but if I leave town for that long, I have to leave my bird behind.
So listen, can I give you my Cochin? You'd honestly be doing me a favor.
You serious?
Well, I hate to let my champ go, but there's no way I can bring it to Macau with me.
It'll make me feel better knowing my bird's with an owner like you. You're the kind of guy who raises his Cochin to win.
Do me this favor. Can you raise my boy up right? With tender, loving care?
(Good thing he's not asking for money. I guess it wouldn't hurt.)
Great! I'm sure you'll bring out his true potential. Either way, he's yours now.
You got a <Color:8>Strong-looking Cochin Chicken<Color:Default>.
Okay. I'm not leaving for Macau just yet, so come back if you change your mind.
Hey! Change your mind about taking my bird?
He's all yours. Well, guess I'd better be heading off to Macau... Can't wait to see him all grown up and happy when I come back!
I'm back! Chargin' went on a little long!
Alrighty! It's... HYPER. YONASHIRO. TIME.
Uh, all you did was take your hat off. Is that all this "hyper" business is about?
Man, and I thought you were at least sharp enough to cut butter! Like I told ya, I'm uncappin' my power level! Cap on equals regular. Cap off equals ASS-KICKIN' HYPER TIME!
Umm... Are you all right?
Why does everyone keep askin' me that!? Shut up and fight me! Fight meee!
Holy... Shit... You did it. You beat my final form!
Hold... Hold on... Goin' Hyper Yonashiro takes a lot outta me. Gotta... rest.
You sure fought a lot harder this time. I don't get how taking your hat off makes such a big difference, though.
Nah, man. I couldn't beat you even in hyper mode. I'm small time. Maybe I oughta sign up to apprentice with the weapon master dude 'round these parts. Maybe that'll help me become big time!
Weapon master?
Didn't ya know? Word is there's a top weapon master right here in this city. The enticing scent of his skill is what drew me here in the first place.
Now, if you'll excuse me, I'm gonna get him to kick my ass until there's nothin' left to kick. Then I'll rise from the ashes a new man! The Omega Yonashiro!
Okey dokey, pokey! Catch ya later!
(Strange guy. I hope he makes it through the qualifiers.)
Doesn't look like anyone's here.
You have business here, too?
No, I was just...
Well, it looks like we both wasted our time, since no one's here.
But the guy who runs the place is usually over on <Color:7>West Ose Bridge Boulevard<Color:Default> when he's not here.
I'm good, though. It's too far for me. I can wait till later.
(<Color:7>West Ose Bridge Boulevard<Color:Default>, huh? That's near my apartment. Maybe I should look into what kind of place he's got here.)
Hello. Please purchase a meal ticket.
You're underage, aren't you, miss? I'm sorry, but I'm not allowed to serve you any alcohol.
Hello, Kiryu-san. What can I get you?
Kiryu-san, I think you've had enough.
Would you like another, Kiryu-san?
I see. Please do come again.
Welcome. Have you decided what you would like to order?
Excuse me, but I think you've had enough.
Would you like another?
Uncle Kaz, wanna hear a joke about tuna? Um... Actually, can you just get me a <Color:8>Tuna Onigiri<Color:Default>, please?
(Haruka wants a <Color:8>Tuna Onigiri<Color:Default>. I think I already heard that joke...)
Aw, but I wanted a <Color:8>Tuna Onigiri<Color:Default>... I didn't even tell the joke this time.
I have some items from the Online Shop. Please take a look.
You received a package from the Online Shop.
Thank you. We look forward to having you again.
You're here to pick up your items? Which one would you like to pick up?
I was told, "I will only send an item pack once."  Please come again.
